zh: 出了大门，两个人都没有坐轿子。嵇家住在清波门，离“柳浪闻莺”不远，安步当车到了那里，在一家叫做“别有天”的馆子里落座。胡雪岩好整以暇地跟嵇鹤龄研究要什么菜，什么酒，那样子就象多年知好，常常在一起把杯小叙似的。“雪岩兄，”嵇鹤龄开门见山地问，“王太守真的认为新城那件案子，非我去不可？”“这倒不大清楚。不过前天我听他在埋怨黄抚台。”胡雪岩喝口酒，闲闲地又说，“埋怨上头，派了这么多委员来，用得着的不多，倒不如只派嵇某人一位，那反倒没有话说。”“怎么叫没有话说？”“听他的口气，是指你老兄没有话说。如果委员只有你一位，他有什么借重的地方，我想你也不好推辞。现在有这么多人，偏偏一定说要请你去，这话他似乎不便出口。”“是啊！”嵇鹤龄说，“我也知道他的难处。”
en: Neither man took a chair when they left the house. Ji lived near Qingbo Gate, not far from the Willows Where Orioles Sing, so they walked there at leisure and sat down in a restaurant called Bieyoutian, “Another World.” Hu calmly discussed the choice of dishes and wine with Ji, as though they were old friends accustomed to meeting over a cup. “Brother Xueyan,” Ji asked directly, “does Prefect Wang really believe that no one but me can handle the Xincheng case?” “I'm not quite sure. But the day before yesterday I heard him complaining about Governor Huang.” Hu sipped his wine and continued casually. “He said the authorities had sent so many commissioners, yet few were of any use. Better to have sent Ji alone; then there would have been nothing to say.” “What did he mean, ‘nothing to say’?” “From his tone, I think he meant that you would have had no grounds to refuse. If you were the only commissioner and he needed your help, I imagine you could hardly decline. But with so many here, it seems awkward for him to insist on choosing you.” “Yes,” Ji said. “I understand his difficulty.”

zh: 知道王有龄的难处又如何呢？胡雪岩心里这样在问，但不愿操之过急，紧钉着问，同时他也真的不急，因为嵇鹤龄的脾气，他几乎已完全摸到，只要能说动他，他比什么人的心还热。果然，嵇鹤龄接着又说：“这件事我当仁不让。不过，王太守得要能听我的话。”胡雪岩也真会做做，“到底怎么回事？我还不十分清楚，这是公事，我最好少说话。鹤龄兄，王太守跟我关系不同，想来你总也听说过。我们虽是初交，一见投缘，说句实话，我是高攀，只要你愿意交我这个朋友，我们交下去一定是顶好的朋友。为此，”他停了一下，装出毅然决然的神情，“我也不能不替你着想，交朋友不能‘治一经，损一经’，你说是不是？”“是的。”嵇鹤龄深深点头、“雪岩兄，不是我恭维你、阛阓中人，象你这样有春秋战国策士味道的，还真罕见。“这两句话，胡雪岩听不懂，反正只知道是恭维的话，谦逊总不铭的，便拱拱手答道：”不敢，不敢！“
en: And what would he do about it? Hu asked himself. But he did not want to press too hard or too soon. In fact, he felt no urgency, for he had almost completely understood Ji's temperament. Once persuaded, Ji would be more eager to help than anyone. Sure enough, he continued, “This is a duty I should not shrink from. But Prefect Wang must be willing to listen to me.” Hu knew how to play his part. “What exactly is involved? I still don't fully understand. It's official business, so I'd better say little. Brother Heling, you've doubtless heard that Prefect Wang and I are unusually close. Though you and I have only just met, we've taken to each other immediately. Frankly, I aspire to a friendship above my station. If you're willing to accept me, I'm sure we shall become the best of friends. For that reason...” He paused, assuming a resolute expression. “I must consider your interests too. Friendship cannot mean helping one man at another's expense. Wouldn't you agree?” “Indeed.” Ji nodded deeply. “Brother Xueyan, this is no empty compliment: it's rare to find a merchant with the qualities of the persuasive strategists of the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods.” Hu did not understand the reference, but knew it was praise. Modesty could not go wrong, so he clasped his hands. “You are too kind!”

zh: “现在我要请问，你说‘不能不替我着想’，是如何想法？”“你的心太热，自告奋勇要到新城走一趟，王太守当然也有借重的意思。不过他的想法跟我一样，总要不生危险才好，如果没有万全之计，还是不去的好。倘或王太守谈到这件事，你有难处，尽管实说。“他加重语气又说：”千万千万不能冒险。这就是我替你着想的地方。““承情之至。”嵇鹤龄很坦然地说：“这种事没有万全之计的，全在乎事先策划周详，临事随机应变。雪岩兄，你放心，我自保的办法，总是有的。”
en: “Now tell me: when you say you must consider my interests, what do you mean?” “You're warm-hearted enough to volunteer for Xincheng, and Prefect Wang certainly wants your help. But he thinks as I do: you must not expose yourself to danger. Unless there's a completely safe plan, better not to go. If he raises the matter and you see difficulties, speak frankly.” Hu strengthened his tone. “Above all, don't take risks. That's what I mean by considering your interests.” “I'm deeply obliged.” Ji answered calmly. “There's no completely safe plan for such a business. Everything depends on thorough preparation and the ability to adapt when the moment comes. Rest assured, Brother Xueyan: I do have ways of protecting myself.”

zh: “可惜，新城是在山里，如果是水路码头我就可以保你的驾了。”“怎么呢？”嵇鹤龄问：“你跟水师营很熟？”“不是。”胡雪岩想了想，觉得不妨实说，“漕帮中我有人。”“那好极了！”嵇鹤龄已极其兴奋地，“我就想结识几个漕帮中人，烦你引见。”他接着又加了一句：“并无他意，只是向往这些人的行径，想印证一下《游侠列传》，看看今古有何不同？”《游侠列传》是个什么玩意？胡雪岩不知道，片刻之间，倒有两次听不懂他的活，心里不免难过，读的书到底太少了。不过不懂他能猜，看样子嵇鹤龄只是想结交这些朋友，江湖上人四海碍很，朋友越多越好，介绍他跟郁四和尤五认识，决不嫌冒昧，所以他一口答应。“鹤龄兄，”他说，“我是‘空子’，就这年把当中，在水路上文了两个响当当的好朋友，一个在湖州，一个在松江。等你公事完了，我也从上海回来了，那时候我们一起到湖州去玩一趟，自然是扰王太守的，我跟你介绍一个姓郁的朋友。照你的性情，你们一定台得来。”
en: “It's a pity Xincheng is in the mountains. If it were a river port, I could guarantee your safety.” “Why?” Ji asked. “Are you well acquainted with the naval forces?” “No.” After a moment's thought, Hu decided he might as well be candid. “I have friends in the Grain Transport Brotherhood.” “Excellent!” Ji became excited. “I've been wanting to meet some of them. You must introduce me.” He added, “I have no ulterior purpose. I'm simply interested in the way these men live. I'd like to compare them with the Biographies of Knight-Errants and see how the present differs from the past.” What were the Biographies of Knight-Errants? Hu had no idea. Twice in a few moments he had failed to understand Ji, and it troubled him. He really had read too few books. But what he did not know he could guess. Evidently Ji merely wished to make these acquaintances. Men of the brotherhood were expansive in their friendships; the more friends, the better. Neither Yu Si nor You Wu would think the introduction presumptuous. Hu agreed at once. “Brother Heling, I'm an outsider. But in the past year or so I've made two splendid friends on the waterways, one in Huzhou and one in Songjiang. When your official business is finished and I've returned from Shanghai, let's visit Huzhou together. Naturally we'll impose on Prefect Wang. I'll introduce you to a friend named Yu. With your temperament, you're certain to get on.”

zh: “好极了！”嵇鹤龄欣然引杯，干了酒又问：“你什么时候动身到上海？”“本来前天就该走了。想想不能把王太守一个人丢在这里，所以上了船又下船。”“啊！这我又要浮一大白！”嵇鹤龄自己取壶斟满，一饮而尽，向胡雪岩照一照杯又说：“现在能够象你这样急人之难。古道热肠的，不多了。”这句话他听懂了，机变极快，应声答道：“至少还有一个，就是仁兄大人阁下。”说着，胡雪岩回敬了一杯，嵇鹤龄欣然接受，放下杯子，有着喜不自胜的神情，“雪岩兄，人生遇合，真正是佛家所说的‘因缘’两字，一点都强求不来。”“喔，原来‘姻缘’两字，是佛经上来的？”
en: “Excellent!” Ji gladly raised his cup. After draining it, he asked, “When do you leave for Shanghai?” “I should have left the day before yesterday. But I couldn't abandon Prefect Wang here alone, so I got off the boat after boarding it.” “Ah! That deserves another full cup!” Ji took the wine pot, filled his cup, drank it dry, and showed it to Hu. “Few men nowadays are so quick to help a friend in trouble or so generous in the old-fashioned way.” This Hu understood. His reply was immediate. “There is at least one other: your most distinguished self.” He returned the toast, which Ji happily accepted. Setting down his cup, Ji looked almost overcome with pleasure. “Brother Xueyan, meetings between people truly depend on what the Buddhists call yinyuan—causes and affinities. You cannot force them in the least.” “Oh, so yinyuan comes from Buddhist scripture?” Hu had taken the word to mean the ties that bring a marriage about.

zh: 这一说，嵇鹤龄不免诧异，看他吐属不凡，何以连“因缘”的出典都会不知道呢？但他轻视的念头，在心中一闪即没，朋友投缘了，自会有许多忠恕的想法，他在想，胡雪岩虽是生意中人，没有读多少书，但并不俗气，而且在应酬交往中，学到了一口文雅的谈吐，居然在场面上能充得过去，也真个难能可贵了。他还没有听出胡雪岩说的是“姻缘”，不是“因缘”。只接着发挥他的看法：“世俗都道得一个‘缘’字，其实有因才有缘。你我的性情，就是一个因，你晓得我吃软不吃硬，人穷志不穷的脾气，这样才会投缘。所以有人说的无缘，其实是无因，彼此志趣不台，性情不投，哪里会做得成朋友？”胡雪岩这才明白，他说的是因果之“因”，不是婚姻之“姻”，心里越发不是味道，但也不必掩饰。“鹤龄兄，”他很诚恳的说，“你跟我谈书上的道理，我不是你的对手。不过你尽管谈，我听听总是有益的。”
en: Ji was surprised. Hu spoke so well; how could he not know the origin of yinyuan? Yet the passing trace of condescension vanished at once. When friends take to one another, charitable explanations readily follow. Though a merchant with little schooling, Hu was not vulgar. Through social intercourse he had acquired an elegant way of speaking that carried him creditably through formal occasions. That was no small achievement. Ji had not yet noticed that Hu understood a different word, also pronounced yinyuan: marriage ties rather than causes and affinities. He simply developed his thought. “People speak only of affinity, but there must be a cause before affinity can arise. Our temperaments are one such cause. You understood that I respond to kindness, not pressure, and that poverty hasn't destroyed my self-respect. That's why we get on. When people say they lack affinity, what they really lack is a cause for it. If their aspirations differ and their temperaments clash, how can they become friends?” Only then did Hu realise that Ji meant yin as in cause and effect, not yin as in marriage. He felt still more uncomfortable, but saw no need to conceal it. “Brother Heling,” he said sincerely, “when it comes to principles from books, I'm no match for you. But please go on. Listening can only do me good.”

zh: 这一说，益使嵇鹤龄觉得他坦率可爱，不过也因为他这一说，反倒不便再引经据典，谈谈书上的道理了，“ ‘世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章’，雪岩兄，你倒也不必忒自谦。”嵇鹤龄说，“我劝你闲下来，倒不妨读几首诗，看看山，看看水，这倒是涵泳性情，于你极有益处的。”“你这几句话是张药方子，”胡雪岩笑道：“可以医我的俗气。”“对了！”嵇鹤龄击节称赏，“你见得到此就不俗。”这一来，他的谈兴越发好了，谈兴一好酒兴也一定好，又添了两斤竹叶青来。酒店主人也很识趣，从吊在湖水中的竹篓里，捞起一条三斤重的青鱼，别出心裁，舍弃从南宋传下来的“醋溜”成法不用，仿照“老西儿”的吃法，做了碗解酒醒脾的醋椒鱼汤，亲自捧上桌来，说明是不收钱的“敬菜”。于是嵇鹤龄的饭量也好了，三碗“冬春米”饭下肚，摩着肚皮说：“从内人下世以来，我还是第一次这么酒醉饭饱。”
en: This made Ji like him still more for his candour, though it also left him reluctant to continue displaying quotations and book learning. “To understand the world is learning; to comprehend human dealings is literature. Brother Xueyan, there's no need to be so modest. When you have leisure, try reading a few poems and looking at mountains and water. It would nourish your temperament and do you a great deal of good.” “Those words are a prescription,” Hu said with a smile. “They could cure my vulgarity.” “Exactly!” Ji tapped in appreciation. “A man who sees that is no vulgar fellow.” His pleasure in conversation increased, and with it his appetite for wine. They ordered another two jin of Zhuyeqing. The proprietor, too, knew how to oblige. From a bamboo basket suspended in the lake, he took a black carp weighing three jin. Instead of preparing it in the traditional vinegar style handed down from the Southern Song, he borrowed a Shanxi method and made a fish soup with vinegar and pepper, refreshing to the stomach and calculated to clear the effects of wine. He brought it himself, explaining that it was a complimentary dish. Ji's appetite improved as well. After three bowls of dongchun rice, he rubbed his stomach. “This is the first time since my wife died that I've eaten and drunk to such contentment.”

zh: 他这一说，倒让胡雪岩想起一件事，“鹤龄兄，”他问：“尊夫人故世，留下五六个儿子，中馈不可无人，你也该有续弦的打算！”“唉！”嵇鹤龄叹口气，“我何尝不作此打算？不过，你倒想想，五六个儿女需要照料，又是不知哪一年补缺的‘灾官’，请问，略略过得去的人家，哪位小姐肯嫁我？”“这倒是实话。”胡雪岩说：“等我来替你动动脑筋！”嵇鹤龄笑笑不答。胡雪岩却真的在替他“动脑筋”，并且很快地想到了一个主意，但眼前先不说破，谈了些别的闲话，看着太阳已落入南北高峰之间，返照湖水，映出万点金鳞，暑气也不如日中之烈，柳下披风，醉意一消，真个“夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏”，一到黄昏，城门快要关了，两人恋恋不舍地约了明天再见。
en: The remark reminded Hu of something. “Brother Heling, your wife left five or six children. Someone must manage the household. Surely you've considered marrying again?” “Ah!” Ji sighed. “Of course I have. But consider it: five or six children to look after, and a wretched expectant official who doesn't know what year he'll receive a post. What daughter of even a moderately respectable family would marry me?” “That's true,” Hu replied. “Let me think about it for you.” Ji merely smiled. Hu, however, really did think, and soon had an idea. He kept it to himself for the moment and turned to other small talk. The sun had sunk between the Northern and Southern Peaks, scattering ten thousand golden scales across the lake. The heat was less fierce than at noon, and a breeze beneath the willows cleared their heads. Truly, “The setting sun is beautiful beyond measure, but twilight is near.” Twilight meant the city gates would soon close. Reluctantly, they parted, agreeing to meet the next day.

zh: 胡雪岩直接来到王家，王有龄正好送客出门，一见便拉着他的手笑道：“雪岩，你的本事真大，居然能把这么个人降服了，我不能不佩服你。我去拜过他了，封了八两银子的奠仪，不算太菲吧！”“这无所谓。”胡雪岩答道，“他已经自告奋勇，明天上午一定会来回拜，你就开门见山跟他谈好了。”“自告奋勇？”王有龄愁怀尽去，大喜说道：“好极，好极！明天晚上我请个客，把魁参将和新城县的两个绅士约了来，好好谈一谈。你早点来！”第二天下午，胡雪岩依约，在家吃完午饭就到了王家。不久，嵇鹤龄也到了，他在上午已来回拜过王有龄，接受了晚宴的邀请，同时应约早到，好先商量出一个具体办法，等魁参将和新城县的绅士来了，当面谈妥，立即就可以动手办事。
en: Hu went straight to Wang's house. Wang was seeing a visitor out. As soon as he saw Hu, he caught his hand and laughed. “Xueyan, you're astonishing! To win over a man like that—I can only admire you. I've called on him and left eight taels as a condolence offering. That wasn't too little, was it?” “The amount doesn't matter,” Hu replied. “He's already volunteered. He'll certainly return your visit tomorrow morning, and you can speak to him directly.” “Volunteered?” All Wang's worries vanished. “Excellent! I'll give a dinner tomorrow evening and invite Brigade Commander Kui and the two gentlemen from Xincheng. We can discuss everything properly. Come early.” The next afternoon, Hu finished lunch at home and went to Wang's as arranged. Ji soon arrived too. He had returned Wang's call that morning and accepted the dinner invitation. They had also agreed that he should come early so they could devise a concrete plan. Once Kui and the Xincheng gentlemen arrived, they could settle it together and begin work immediately.

zh: “鹤龄兄，”王有龄说，“早晨你来过以后，我一直在盘算，新城县令已为匪僧慧心戕害，现在是县丞护印。我想上院保老兄署理新城，有‘印把子’在手里，办事比较方便。当然，这是权宜之计，新城地瘠民贫，不好一直委屈老兄。将来调补一等大县，我一定帮忙。”“多谢雪公栽培！”嵇鹤龄拱拱手说，“不过眼前还是用委员的名义好。何以呢？第一，此去要随机应变，说不定我要深入虎穴，权且与那班乱民‘称兄道弟，杯酒言欢’。如果是父母官的身分，不能不存朝廷的体统，处处拘束，反而不便。其次，现在既是县丞护印，身处危城，能够尽心维持，他总也有所贪图，如果我一署理，他就落空了，即使不是心怀怨望，事事掣时，也一定鼓不起劲来干，于大事无益。“
en: “Brother Heling,” Wang began, “I've been considering matters ever since your visit this morning. The rebel monk Huixin has murdered the Xincheng magistrate, and the county's deputy magistrate is now holding the seal. I mean to recommend you to the governor as acting magistrate. With the seal of authority in your hands, your work would be easier. Of course, this would only be temporary. Xincheng has poor soil and impoverished inhabitants. You shouldn't be kept in such an unrewarding post. Later I'll certainly help you transfer to a large county of the first class.” Ji clasped his hands. “Thank you for advancing my interests, Mr Xuexuan. But for now I should retain the title of commissioner. Why? First, I must adapt to circumstances. I may have to enter the tiger's den and temporarily call those rebels brothers, drinking with them on friendly terms. As their magistrate, I would have to preserve the dignity of the court. That would constrain me everywhere and make things harder. Second, the deputy magistrate is holding the seal and doing his best to sustain a city in danger. He must hope to gain something for his efforts. If I take the acting appointment, his hopes disappear. Even if he doesn't resent it and obstruct me at every turn, he'll certainly lose his enthusiasm. That would do our purpose no good.”

zh: “是，是！”王有龄钦佩之忱，溢于词色，“老兄这番剖析，具见卓识。这准定照老兄的吩咐，等这件事完了，老兄补实缺的事，包在我身上。““那是以后的事，眼前我要请雪公先跟上头进言，新城县丞，倘或著有劳绩，请上头不必另外派人，就让他升署知县。”嵇鹤龄说，“‘重赏之下，必有勇夫’这句话，有时候很用得着。如果上头肯这么答应，我到了新城，可得许多方便。”“对！这也是应该的。危城之中，也靠他撑持，理当有此酬庸。倘或受罪吃辛苦有分，局势平定了，别人来坐享其成，这也太不公平了。”接着，他们两人便谈到“先抚后剿”的细节。胡雪岩看没有他的事，也插不进话去，便悄悄退了出来，径到上房来见王太太。
en: “Yes, yes!” Wang's admiration showed in both his words and expression. “Your analysis displays real insight. We'll do exactly as you advise. Once this affair is settled, leave your substantive appointment to me.” “That is for later. For now, please recommend to the authorities that if the deputy magistrate of Xincheng renders distinguished service, they should promote him to act as magistrate instead of sending someone else. ‘A generous reward will bring forth brave men’ is sometimes a very useful principle. With that promise from above, my work in Xincheng would become much easier.” “Quite right! And he deserves it. He's holding the place together in danger and should receive that recognition. It would be grossly unfair to leave him all the hardship, then let another man enjoy the fruits once order is restored.” They went on to discuss the details of attempting conciliation before resorting to force. Hu saw no part for himself and could contribute nothing, so he quietly withdrew and went straight to the inner rooms to see Mrs Wang.

zh: 王太太越发亲热，口口声声“兄弟，兄弟”的，简直把他当做娘家人看待了。胡雪岩深知官场中人的脾气，只许他们亲热，不许别人越礼，所以仍旧按规矩称她：“王太太！”他说，“现在你可以不必再为雪公担心了。嵇鹤龄一则是佩服雪公，再则是跟我一见如故，肯到新城去了。”“这都是兄弟你的功劳！”王太太很吃力地说：“真正是，我不知道该怎么谢你？”“不必谢我！就算我出了力，以我跟雪公的情分来说，也是应该的。倒是人家嵇老爷，打开天窗说亮话，这一趟去，真正要承他的情。”胡雪岩又说，“刚刚雪公要保他署理新城县，他一定不要，说是这一来事情反倒不好办。王太太你想，候补候补。 就是想补个缺，此刻不贪功名富贵，所为何来？无非交情二字。“
en: Mrs Wang was warmer than ever, calling him “Brother” at every turn and treating him almost as a member of her own family. Hu understood official households: they might be familiar, but others must not overstep the forms. He therefore continued to address her properly. “Mrs Wang, you needn't worry about Mr Xuexuan any longer. Ji Heling admires him, and he and I felt like old friends at our first meeting. He's agreed to go to Xincheng.” “It's all your doing, Brother!” she said with difficulty. “Truly, I don't know how to thank you.” “There's no need. Even if I have been of some help, with my friendship for Mr Xuexuan it was only right. Mr Ji is the one we truly owe. To speak plainly, we must appreciate what he's doing by going there.” Hu continued, “Just now Mr Xuexuan offered to recommend him as acting magistrate, but he firmly refused, saying it would make the work harder. Think of it: an expectant official waits for nothing but a post. Why would he put aside rank and advancement when they're offered? Simply for friendship.”

zh: “这是真的。”王太太说：“兄弟我们自己人，你倒替我出个主意看，虽说公事上头，我不能问，也插不进手去，私人的情分上他帮了你哥哥这么一个大忙，我总也要尽点心。如果他太太在世，倒也好了，内眷往来，什么话都好说，偏偏他太太又故世了！”这就说到紧要关头上来了，胡雪岩三两句话把话题引到此处，正要开门见山转入正文，不想来了个人，他只好把已到喉咙口的话，咽了回去。“胡老爷请用茶。钱塘县陈大老爷送的狮子山的‘ 旗枪’还是头一回打开来吃。胡老爷，你是讲究吃茶的，尝尝新！”说话的是王太太的一个心腹丫头，名叫瑞云，生得长身玉立，一张长隆脸，下巴宽了些，但照相法上说，这是所谓主贵的“地角方圆”。看瑞云的气度，倒确是有点大家闺秀的味道，语言从容，神态娴静，没有些儿轻狂。尤其好的是操持家务，井井有条，等于王太太的一条右臂。所以到了花信年华，依然是小姑居处，只为王太太舍不得放她出去。
en: “That's true,” Mrs Wang said. “Brother, we're among ourselves. Give me some advice. I can't inquire into official business or interfere with it, but personally he's doing your elder brother a great service. I must show some consideration too. If his wife were alive, it would be easier. We women could visit, and anything could be discussed. Unfortunately, she's dead.” This was the crucial point. Hu had guided the conversation here in a few sentences and was about to state his purpose when someone arrived. He swallowed the words already on his tongue. “Please have some tea, Mr Hu. It's flag-and-spear tea from Lion Hill, sent by Magistrate Chen of Qiantang. We've only just opened it. You're particular about tea—do try this fresh batch.” The speaker was Mrs Wang's trusted maid, Ruiyun. Tall and graceful, she had a long face and a rather broad chin. In physiognomy, however, a full, well-shaped lower face was supposed to promise distinction. Her bearing did indeed suggest a young woman from a good family. She spoke calmly, carried herself quietly, and showed no frivolity. Her particular gift was household management: she kept everything in perfect order and was virtually Mrs Wang's right arm. Thus, though well into marriageable adulthood, she remained unmarried, simply because her mistress could not bear to let her go.

zh: “多谢，多谢！”胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地问道：“瑞云，你今年几岁？”瑞云最怕人问她的年纪，提起来有点伤心，但她到底与众不同，这时大大方方地答道：“我今年二十二。”其实是二十五，瞒掉了三岁。“二十二岁倒不象。”胡雪岩有意叫她开开心，“我当你二十岁不到。”瑞云笑了，笑得很大方，也很妩媚，只是嘴大了些、好在有雪白整齐的一嘴牙，倒也丝毫不显得难看。“兄弟！”王太太有些紧张，“你……”胡雪岩重重咳嗽了一声，示意她不要说下去，她要说的一句话他知道，当着瑞云诸多不便，所以阻止。瑞云怎会看不出来？顺手取走了王太太的一只茶杯，毫不着痕迹地躲了开去。这时王太太才低声问道：“兄弟，你是不是要替瑞云做媒？”
en: “Thank you, thank you!” Hu smiled. “Ruiyun, how old are you?” She dreaded being asked her age; the subject hurt her. Yet she was no ordinary woman and answered with composure. “Twenty-two this year.” She was actually twenty-five and had subtracted three years. “You don't look twenty-two,” Hu said, deliberately trying to please her. “I thought you were under twenty.” Ruiyun smiled openly and charmingly. Her mouth was rather large, but her even white teeth kept the smile from being unattractive in the least. “Brother!” Mrs Wang sounded anxious. “Are you...” Hu coughed loudly to stop her. He knew what she was about to ask and thought it awkward to say before Ruiyun. How could Ruiyun fail to notice? Taking one of Mrs Wang's teacups, she unobtrusively withdrew. Only then did Mrs Wang ask quietly, “Brother, do you mean to find Ruiyun a husband?”

zh: “有是有这么个想法，先要看王太太的意思。”胡雪岩老实说道：“我看耽误不得了！”王太太脸一红，“我也不瞒你，”她说，“一则来高不成低不就，二则来，我实在也离不开她。”“这是从前的话，现在不同了。”“是的，不同。”王太太说是这样说，其实不过礼貌上的附和，究竟如何不同，她自己并不知道，胡雪岩看出这一点，自恃交情深厚，觉得有为她坦率指出的必要，不然，话就谈不下去了。“王太太！一年多以前，雪公还不曾进京，那时府上的境况，我也有些晓得。多亏王太太一手调度，熬过这段苦日子，雪公才能脱运交运，当时自然少不了瑞云这样一个得力帮手……”“啊！”不等他的话完，王太太便抢着打断，是一脸愧歉不安的神情，“兄弟，你说得不错！真正亏得你提醒！”今昔的不同，让胡雪岩提醒了。做主人家的，宦途得意，扶摇直上，做下人的又如何呢？瑞云帮王家撑过一段苦日子，现在也该有所报答了，再不替她的终身着想，白白耽误了青春，于心何忍呢？因此，这时候的王太太，不仅是不安，甚至于可说有些着急，最好能立刻找到一个年貌相当，有出息的人，把瑞云嫁了出去。
en: “I do have that thought, though I must first know your wishes,” Hu answered frankly. “I don't think it can be put off any longer.” Mrs Wang blushed. “I won't conceal it from you. First, the higher matches are beyond us and the lower ones won't do. Second, I really can't manage without her.” “That was true before. Things are different now.” “Yes, different.” She was merely agreeing politely; she did not really know how things had changed. Hu saw this. Trusting in the closeness of their friendship, he thought he must explain plainly, or the conversation would go no further. “Mrs Wang, a little over a year ago, before Mr Xuexuan went to the capital, I knew something of your circumstances. It was your management that carried the household through those hard times and allowed his fortune to turn. Naturally, then, you couldn't do without a capable helper like Ruiyun...” “Ah!” She interrupted before he could finish, her face full of uneasy remorse. “You're right, Brother! Thank you for reminding me.” He had made her see the difference between then and now. The masters were enjoying official success and rising rapidly; what of the servants? Ruiyun had helped them endure hardship and deserved some reward. How could Mrs Wang bear to neglect her future and let her youth slip away? She was now not merely uneasy but anxious to find, immediately if possible, a promising husband of suitable age and appearance for Ruiyun.

zh: “兄弟，你说，你要替我们瑞云做媒的是哪家？什么出身？有多大年纪？如果谈得拢，我要相相亲。“听她这关切起劲的语气，可知祈望甚奢，嵇鹤龄不可能明媒正娶把瑞云当“填房”，又有六个未成年的儿女，这些情形一说，王太太立刻会摇头。上手之初就碰个钉子，以后就能够挽回，也很吃力。所以胡雪岩心里在想，第一句话说出去，就要她动心，不能驳回。这就要用点手腕了！反正王太太对瑞云再关切，也比不上她对丈夫的关切，不妨就从这上面下手。于是他说：“王太太，这头亲事，跟雪公也大有关系，我说成了，诸事顺利，说不成难免有麻烦。”
en: “Tell me, Brother, whose family is it? What is the man's background? How old is he? If the proposal seems suitable, I want to see him for myself.” Her eager concern showed that her expectations were high. Ji could not take Ruiyun as a formally married successor to his late wife, and he had six children still under age. Mention either fact, and Mrs Wang would shake her head at once. If Hu met a refusal at the outset, recovering the position would be difficult even if possible. His first words must move her and leave no room for rejection. That required a little manoeuvring. However much she cared for Ruiyun, she cared more for her husband. He could begin there. “Mrs Wang, this marriage concerns Mr Xuexuan closely too. If I arrange it, everything will go smoothly. If I fail, trouble may follow.”

zh: 为他所料的，王太太一听，神态又是一变，不仅关切。还有警惕，“兄弟，你来说，没有说不成的道理。”她这样答道，“你做的事都是不错的！”这句话答得很好，使胡雪岩觉得双肩的责任加重，不能不为瑞云设想，因而不即回答，在心里把嵇鹤龄的各方面又考虑了一遍。经过这短暂的沉默，王太太也有所领悟了，“你说的那个人，是不是嵇老爷？”她率直问说。“就是他！”胡雪岩也考虑停当了，“王太太，我要说句老实话，瑞云如果想嫁个做官的，先总只有委屈几年。”接下去他说：“至于嵇鹤龄这个人，你想也可以想到，人品、才干都呱呱叫，将来一定会得意。瑞云嫁了他，一定有的好日子过。”王太太不响，盘算一会问道：“ 嵇老爷今年多大？”“四十刚刚出头。”胡雪岩说，“人生得后生，看来只有三十多，精神极好。”“脾气呢？”“有才干的人，总是有脾气的，不过脾气不会在家里发，在家里象只老虎，在外头象只‘煨灶猫’，这种是最没出息的人。”“原是！”王太太笑道：“只会在家里打老婆，算什么男子汉？”她紧接着又说，“提起这一层，我倒想起来了，怎么说先要瑞云‘委屈’两年，这话我不大懂。”
en: As he had expected, her expression changed again. Concern was joined by vigilance. “Brother, if you're arranging it, there's no reason it shouldn't succeed. Whatever you do is sound.” It was an excellent answer. It made Hu feel the weight of responsibility and obliged him to consider Ruiyun's interests. Instead of replying immediately, he reviewed Ji's qualities once more. In that brief silence, Mrs Wang understood. “Is the man you mean Mr Ji?” she asked directly. “It is.” Hu had finished his deliberation. “Let me speak frankly. If Ruiyun hopes to marry an official, she'll have to accept some disadvantages for the first few years. As for Ji himself, you can imagine his qualities. His character and ability are first-rate. He's certain to succeed. If she marries him, she will have good days ahead.” Mrs Wang considered silently, then asked, “How old is he?” “Just over forty. He looks young—only in his thirties—and is full of energy.” “What about his temper?” “Talented men generally have a temper, but they don't vent it at home. A man who's a tiger in his house and a timid cat beside the stove outside it is the most hopeless kind.” “Indeed!” Mrs Wang smiled. “What sort of man can do nothing but beat his wife at home?” Then she added, “That reminds me: why did you say Ruiyun must accept disadvantages for a couple of years? I don't quite understand.”

zh: “我是说，刚进门没有什么名分。过个两三年，嵇鹤龄自然会把她‘扶正’。”王太太对此要考虑，考虑的不是眼前是将来，“兄弟，”她说，“你这句话倒也实在。不过，将来嵇老爷另外娶了填房，我们瑞云不是落空了吗？”“这可以言明在先的。”胡雪岩拍拍胸说，“不然找我媒人说话。”“ ‘满饭好吃，满话难说’！我样样事相信你，只有这上头，说实话，我比你见得多，做媒吃力不讨好的，多得很！不然怎么会有‘春媒酱’这句话？我们两家的交情，自然不会这样子，到那时候，就只有叫瑞云委屈了！”“这要看人说话。嵇鹤龄是个说一不二的人，除非不答应，答应了一定有信用。总而言之一句活，只要瑞云真的贤慧能干，嫁过去一定同偕到老。”
en: “I mean she wouldn't have the status of principal wife when she first entered his household. After two or three years, he would naturally elevate her to that position.” Mrs Wang had to consider this, less for the present than for the future. “Brother, you're being frank. But if Mr Ji later marries someone else to replace his wife, wouldn't Ruiyun's hopes come to nothing?” “We can make the condition clear beforehand.” Hu tapped his chest. “If he fails to honour it, come to me, the matchmaker.” “A full bowl is easy to eat; a sweeping promise is hard to keep. I trust you in everything, but on this matter, frankly, I've seen more than you. Many matchmakers labour hard and earn only blame. Otherwise, why would people talk about pounding the matchmaker into paste? Naturally our two families would never behave like that towards each other. If it happened, Ruiyun would simply have to suffer.” “It depends on the man. Ji's word is his bond. He may refuse to promise, but once he agrees, he'll keep faith. In short, if Ruiyun is truly capable and virtuous, they will grow old together.”

zh: “好了，这层不去说他。”王太太又问：“嵇老爷堂上有没有老亲？”“堂上老亲倒没有。底下有六个小鬼！”此是这桩亲事中最大的障碍，胡雪岩特意自己先说破，“不过，王太太，你放心，嵇家的家教极好，六个伢儿都乖得很！”他一路在说，王太太一路摇头，“这难了！”她说，“你们男人家哪里晓得操持家务的苦楚？六个伢儿，光是穿鞋子，一年就要做到头，将来瑞云自己再有了儿女，岂不是苦上加苦？”从这里开始，胡雪岩大费唇舌，他的口才超妙，一向无往不利，只有他这一刻，怎么样也不能把王太太说服。他恭维瑞云能干，繁难的家务，在她手里举重苦轻，又说嵇鹤龄不久就会得意，可以多用婢仆分劳。凡此理由都敌不过王太太一句话：“瑞云苦了多年，我不能再叫她去吃苦！”多说无益，胡雪岩慢慢自己收篷，所以事难不成，和气未伤，王太太当然感到万分歉仄，便留了一个尾巴，说是“慢慢再商量。”
en: “Very well, leave that aside,” Mrs Wang said. “Does Mr Ji have elderly parents?” “No parents above him, but six little devils below!” This was the greatest obstacle to the match, and Hu deliberately raised it himself. “Still, don't worry. The family is well brought up. All six children are very good.” She shook her head as he spoke. “That makes it difficult! What do you men know of the labour of running a household? With six children, making shoes alone would keep her busy all year. If she later has children of her own, wouldn't that add hardship to hardship?” From this point Hu spent a great many words. His eloquence was extraordinary and had usually carried everything before it. Now, however, nothing could persuade Mrs Wang. He praised Ruiyun's ability: she could make light work of the most complicated household. He said Ji would soon advance and could employ more servants to share the burden. Every argument failed before her single answer: “Ruiyun has suffered for years. I won't send her out to suffer again!” Further talk was useless. Hu gradually drew back. Though the affair had failed, goodwill remained intact. Mrs Wang, deeply apologetic, left an opening: “We can discuss it again later.”

zh: 胡雪岩却等不得了，象这样的事，要做得爽利，才能叫人见情：因此他另辟蹊径，从王有龄身上着手。不过要让他硬作主张，王太太也会不高兴，说不定会伤他们夫妻的感情，所以胡雪岩想了一个比较缓和的办法。“太太！”王有龄用商量的语气说：“嵇鹤龄这一趟总算是帮了我们全家一个大忙，刚才在席上已经谈好了，他后天就动身到新城。不过人家帮了我们的忙，我们也要想想人家的难处。”“那自然。”王太太问道，“嵇老爷眼前有啥难处，怎么帮法。”“他是父代母职。等一离了家，虽有个老家人，也照顾不了。我想叫瑞云去替他管几天家。”王太太笑了，“这一定是雪岩想出来的花佯。”“雪岩绝顶聪明，他想出来的花样，不会错的。”
en: Hu could not wait. A favour of this sort had to be carried through briskly if its recipient was to feel its full value. He therefore tried another route, through Wang. But if Wang simply overruled his wife, she would be unhappy and their marriage might suffer. Hu devised a gentler plan. “My dear,” Wang said in a consultative tone, “Ji Heling is doing our whole family a great service. We've just settled it over dinner: he'll leave for Xincheng the day after tomorrow. Since he's helping us, we must consider his difficulties too.” “Naturally. What difficulties does he have just now, and how can we help?” “He's acting as both father and mother. Once he leaves, the old family servant won't be able to manage everything. I'd like Ruiyun to keep house for him for a few days.” Mrs Wang smiled. “This must be one of Xueyan's devices.” “He's exceptionally clever. A device of his won't go wrong.”

zh: “我不是说他错。”王太太问：“不过其中到底是什么花样？总也得说出来，我才会明白。““是这样子，雪岩的意思，一则替嵇鹤龄管几天家，让他可以无后顾之忧，二则让瑞云去看看情形，如果觉得嵇鹤龄为人合得来，他家几个孩子也听话，瑞云认为应付得下，那就再好都没有。否则就作罢，从此大家不谈这件事，一点痕迹不留，岂不甚好？”“这好，这好！”王太太大为点头，“这我就没话说了。”“不过我倒要劝你。”王有龄又说，“象嵇鹤龄这样的人，凭心而论，是个人才，只要脾气稍为变得圆通些，以他的仪表才具，不怕不得意。瑞云嫁了他，眼前或许苦一点，将来一定有福享。再说，彼此结成至好，再连上这门亲，你们可以常来常往，不也蛮热闹有趣的吗？”这句话倒是把王太太说动了。既然是讲感情，为瑞云着想以外，也要为自己想想，不管瑞云嫁人为妻还是为妾，堂客的往来，总先要看“官客”的交情，地位不同，行辈不符，“老爷”们少有交往，内眷们就不容易轧得拢淘。自己老爷与嵇老爷，以后定会常在一起，真正成了通家之好，那跟瑞云见面的机会，自然就会多了。因此，她欣欣然把瑞云找了来，将这件事的前后经过，和盘托出，首先也就是强调彼此可以常来常往，接着便许了她一份嫁妆，最后问她的意思如何？
en: “I'm not saying it's wrong,” she replied. “But you must explain the device before I can understand it.” “This is what he means. First, Ruiyun can manage Ji's household for a few days so he can leave without domestic worries. Second, she can see the situation for herself. If she finds him agreeable, the children obedient, and the household within her abilities, nothing could be better. Otherwise we abandon the idea and never mention it again, leaving no trace of the proposal. Wouldn't that be excellent?” “Yes, yes!” Mrs Wang nodded vigorously. “I have no objection to that.” “But let me offer some advice too,” Wang continued. “To be fair, a man like Ji has real talent. If he becomes a little more accommodating, his bearing and ability will certainly bring success. Ruiyun may have some hardship at first, but later she will enjoy prosperity. Besides, once we're close friends and this marriage links us too, you could visit each other often. Wouldn't that be pleasant?” This persuaded her. Affection required some consideration for herself as well as for Ruiyun. Whether Ruiyun became wife or concubine, relations between the women would depend first on relations between the men. Differences of rank or generation, or husbands who rarely met, made it difficult for their households' women to associate comfortably. Wang and Ji would certainly see much of each other. As friends whose families visited freely, they would give her ample opportunity to see Ruiyun. She therefore happily summoned the maid and explained the entire proposal, emphasising first that they could visit often, then promising a dowry, and finally asking what she thought.

zh: 当胡雪岩和王有龄跟王太太在谈此事时，瑞云早就在“听壁脚”了，终身大事，心里一直在盘算，她觉得这时候自以不表示态度为宜，所以这样答道：“嵇老爷替老爷去办公事，他家没有人，我自然该替他去管几天家。以后的事谁晓得呢？”“这话也对！”王太太是想怂恿她好好花些功夫下去，好使得嵇鹤龄倾心，但却不便明言，因而用了个激将法：“不过，我有点担心，他家伢儿多，家也难管，将来说起来，‘管与不管一样’，这句话，就不好听了。”瑞云不响，心里冷笑，怎说“管与不管一样”呢？明天管个样子出来看肴，你就知道了。
en: Ruiyun had already been listening through the wall while Hu and Wang discussed the matter with their mistress. It concerned the rest of her life, and she had been considering it throughout. She felt it best not to declare herself yet. “Mr Ji is undertaking official business for the master. With no one to manage his household, naturally I should do it for a few days. Who can say what comes afterwards?” “That's reasonable too.” Mrs Wang wanted her to make a special effort and win Ji's heart, but could not say so openly. Instead she challenged her pride. “Only I'm a little worried. He has so many children, and the household will be hard to manage. It would sound very bad if people later said, ‘Her being there made no difference.’” Ruiyun said nothing, but inwardly scoffed. No difference? She would show them what proper management looked like tomorrow. Then they would know.

zh: 于是第二天一早，瑞云带了个衣箱，由高升陪着，一顶小轿，来到嵇家。嵇鹤龄已预先听胡雪岩来说过，深为领情，对瑞云自然也另眼相看，称她“瑞姑娘”，让儿女们叫她“瑞阿姨”。“瑞姑娘，多多费心，多多拜托！”嵇鹤龄不胜感激地说，“有你来帮忙，我可以放心了。这个家从今天起，就算交了给你了，孩子们不乖，该打该骂，不必客气。”“哪有这个道理？”瑞云浅浅地笑首，把他那个大眼睛的小女儿搂在怀里，眼角扫着那五个大的，正好三男三女，老大是男的，看上去极其忠厚老实。老二是女孩，有十二岁左右，生得很瘦，一双眼睛却特别灵活，话也最多，一望而知，不易对付。她心里在想，要把这个家管好，先得把这个“二小姐”收服。“瑞姑娘！”嵇鹤龄打断了她的思路，“我把钥匙交给你。”当家的钥匙，就好比做官的印信，瑞云当仁不让，把一串沉甸甸的钥匙接了过来。接着，嵇鹤龄又唤了张贵和一个名叫小青的小丫头来，为她引见。交代这一些，他站起身来要出门了。
en: Early the next morning, Ruiyun took a clothes chest and travelled in a small sedan chair to Ji's house, accompanied by Gao Sheng. Hu had already explained the arrangement to Ji, who was deeply grateful. He treated Ruiyun with special respect, calling her “Miss Rui” and telling his children to address her as “Aunt Rui.” “Miss Rui, I'm putting you to a great deal of trouble,” he said earnestly. “With your help I can set my mind at rest. From today, I entrust this household to you. If the children misbehave, scold or punish them as necessary. Don't hesitate.” “How could I do such a thing?” she answered with a faint smile, drawing his youngest, large-eyed daughter into her arms while surveying the five older children. There were exactly three boys and three girls. The eldest, a boy, looked thoroughly honest and good-natured. The second was a thin girl of about twelve, with unusually lively eyes and more to say than anyone else. She was plainly not easy to manage. To run this household well, Ruiyun thought, she must first win over this Second Miss. “Miss Rui!” Ji interrupted her thoughts. “Let me give you the keys.” A housekeeper's keys were like an official's seal. Ruiyun accepted the heavy bunch without hesitation. Ji then summoned Zhang Gui and a young maid named Xiaoqing and introduced them. Having explained these arrangements, he rose to go out.

zh: “嵇老爷，”瑞云问，“是不是回家吃饭？”“明天就要动身，今天有好些事要料理，中午赶不回来，晚上有个饭局。”“那么，行李要收拾？”“这要麻烦你了！行李不多带。”嵇鹤龄说，“每趟出门，我都带张贵一起走，这一次不必了。要带些什么东西，张贵知道。”嵇鹤龄到二更天才回家，带了个客人来：胡雪岩。一进门便觉得不同，走廊上不似平常那样黑得不堪辨识，淡月映照，相当明亮，细看时是窗纸重新糊过了。走到里面，只见收拾得井井有条，乱七八糟、不该摆在客厅里的东西，都已移了开去，嵇鹤龄顿有耳目清凉之感，不由得就想起太太在世的日子。
en: “Mr Ji, will you be home for a meal?” Ruiyun asked. “I leave tomorrow, and there's much to arrange today. I can't get back for lunch, and I have a dinner engagement.” “Then your luggage needs packing?” “I must trouble you with that. I won't take much. I usually bring Zhang Gui when I travel, but this time he needn't come. He knows what I require.” Ji did not return until the second watch that evening, bringing a guest: Hu Xueyan. The moment he entered, he felt the difference. The passage was no longer so dark that he could scarcely see. Pale moonlight made it quite bright. Looking closely, he saw that the windows had been repapered. Inside, everything stood in order. All the miscellaneous objects that had cluttered the reception room had been removed. The fresh clarity of the house immediately recalled the days when his wife was alive.

zh: “嵇老爷回来了！”瑞云从里面迎了出来，接着又招呼了胡雪岩。“费心，费心！”嵇鹤龄满面含笑的拱手道谢。“如何？”胡雪岩很得意的笑道：“我说这位瑞姑娘很能干吧！”“岂但能干？才德俱备。”这完全是相亲的话了，否则短期作客，代理家会，哪里谈得到什么“才德”？瑞云懂他们的话，但自觉必须装得不懂。从从容容地指挥小青倒茶、装水烟。等主客二人坐定了才说，煮了香粳米粥在那里，如果觉得饿了，随时可以开出来吃。嵇鹤龄未曾开口，胡雪岩先就欣然道好：“正想吃碗粥！”于是瑞云转身出去，跟着就端了托盘进来，四个碟子，一壶嵇鹤龄吃惯了的‘玫瑰烧“，一瓦罐热粥，食物的味道不知如何？餐具却是异常精洁。嵇鹤龄从太太去世，一切因陋就简，此刻看见吃顿粥也颇象个样子，自然觉得高兴。
en: “Mr Ji is home!” Ruiyun came from the inner rooms to greet him, then welcomed Hu. “You've taken such trouble!” Ji smiled broadly and clasped his hands in thanks. “Well?” Hu asked with satisfaction. “Didn't I say Miss Rui was capable?” “More than capable. She has both ability and virtue.” This was plainly the language of assessing a bride. Otherwise, why speak of “ability and virtue” in a guest temporarily managing the house? Ruiyun understood, but felt she must pretend not to. Calmly she directed Xiaoqing to pour tea and prepare the water pipe. Only when host and guest were seated did she say that she had cooked some fragrant rice congee, ready to serve whenever they felt hungry. Before Ji could answer, Hu welcomed the suggestion. “Just what I was wanting!” Ruiyun went out and returned with a tray: four small dishes, a pot of Ji's usual rose spirit, and an earthenware pot of hot congee. Whatever the food might taste like, the utensils were exceptionally clean and fine. Since his wife's death, Ji had made do with the barest arrangements. To see even a simple supper presented properly naturally pleased him.

zh: “来，来！”他招呼着客人说：“这才叫‘借花献佛’，如果不是瑞姑娘，我简直无可待客。”“嵇老爷！”瑞云心里也舒服，但觉得他老是说这么客气的话，却是大可不必，“你说得我都难为情了。既然来到府上，这都是我该做的事，只怕伺候得不周到，嵇老爷你多包涵！”说着，深深看了他一眼，才低下头去盛粥。看他们这神情，胡雪岩知道好事必谐，便忍不住要开玩笑了，“鹤龄兄，”他说，“你们倒真是相敬如宾！”“原是客人嘛！”嵇鹤龄说：“应当敬重。”瑞云不响，她也懂胡雪岩那句话，只觉得怎么样说都不好，所以仍旧是装作不懂，悄悄退了出去。
en: “Come, come!” he urged his guest. “This truly is offering the Buddha someone else's flowers. Without Miss Rui, I'd have nothing fit to serve you.” “Mr Ji!” Ruiyun was pleased too, though she thought his repeated courtesies unnecessary. “You'll embarrass me. Since I've come here, these things are simply my duty. I only hope you'll forgive anything I fail to do properly.” She gave him a deep look before lowering her head to ladle the congee. From their manner, Hu knew the match would succeed and could not resist a joke. “Brother Heling, you really do treat each other with the respect due to honoured guests!” “She is a guest,” Ji replied. “Of course I should respect her.” The phrase also described the mutual courtesy of an exemplary married couple. Ruiyun understood Hu's meaning but could think of no suitable answer. Still pretending not to understand, she quietly withdrew.

zh: “鹤龄兄，”目送她的背影消失，胡雪岩换了个座位，由对面而侧坐，隔着桌角。低声说道，“此刻我要跟你谈正事了。你看如何？”这样逼着问，嵇鹤龄不无受窘之感，笑着推托说：“等我新城回来，再谈也不迟。”“对！本来应该这样。不过，我等你一走，也要马上赶到上海去。彼此已成知交，我不瞒你，我的一家一当都在那几船丝上，实在怕路上会出毛病，这话一时也说不清楚，且不去谈它。到了上海，我要看机会脱手，说不定要两三个月才能回来，那时你早就回到了杭州。你们情投意合，就等我这个媒人。你们急，我也急，倒不如趁现在做好了媒再走。喜酒赶不赶得上，就无所谓了。”“阁下真是一片热肠！”嵇鹤龄敬了他一杯酒，借此沉吟，总觉得不宜操之过急，便歉然说道：“可能再让我看一看？”
en: Watching her disappear, Hu moved from the seat opposite Ji to one beside him, across the corner of the table. He lowered his voice. “Brother Heling, now for serious business. What do you think?” Pressed so directly, Ji felt embarrassed. He smiled and tried to postpone the matter. “There'll be time to discuss it when I return from Xincheng.” “Certainly. Ordinarily that would be right. But the moment you leave, I must hurry to Shanghai. We're close friends now, so I'll be frank: everything I own is tied up in those boatloads of silk. I'm afraid of trouble on the journey. That's too complicated to explain now, so let it pass. Once in Shanghai, I must wait for an opportunity to sell. It may be two or three months before I return. You'll be back in Hangzhou long before then. Suppose you two are fond of each other and have to wait for the matchmaker. You'd be anxious, and so would I. Better to arrange the match now, before I leave. Whether I make it back for the wedding feast doesn't matter.” “You are kindness itself!” Ji offered him a toast, using the pause to consider. He still felt they should not hurry. “Could you give me a little longer to observe?” he asked apologetically.

zh: “还看什么？”胡雪岩不以为然地问他：“第一，你我的眼光，看这么个人还看不透？第二，如果不是你所说的‘才德俱备’，王太太又何至于当她心肝宝贝样，留到这个岁数还不放？”“这倒是实话。”“再跟你说句实话，纳宠到底不比正娶，不用想得那么多。”“好了！我从命就是了。”嵇鹤龄又敬他酒，表示谢媒。“慢慢，你从我的命，我的命令还没有下呢！”胡雪岩说：“我在王太太面前拍了胸脯来的，如果三两年以后，她没有什么错处，你就要预备送她一副‘诰封’。”“那自然。我也不会再续娶了，将来把她扶正好了。”“话是你说的。”胡雪岩特意再钉一句：“你将来会不会做蔡伯喈、陈世美？这要‘言明在先’，我好有交代。”嵇鹤龄笑了，“亏你想得出！”他说，“我又不会中状元，哪里来的‘相府招亲’？”
en: “What more is there to observe?” Hu objected. “First, with your judgement and mine, can't we see what sort of person she is? Second, unless she possessed the ability and virtue you praised, would Mrs Wang have treasured her so much that she kept her unmarried until this age?” “That's true.” “And frankly, taking a concubine isn't the same as marrying a principal wife. There's no need for so much deliberation.” “Very well. I'll obey.” Ji offered another toast, thanking him as matchmaker. “Not so fast! You promise to obey, but I haven't given my instructions yet. I've pledged my word to Mrs Wang: if after two or three years Ruiyun has given no cause for complaint, you must be ready to obtain an imperial patent of rank for her.” “Naturally. I shan't marry another principal wife. In due course I'll raise her to that position.” “Those are your own words.” Hu deliberately pressed the point. “Will you turn into a Cai Bojie or a Chen Shimei and abandon her later? We must settle this beforehand, so I can answer for it.” Ji laughed. “What an idea! I'm not going to become the top examination graduate. Where would a prime minister's offer of his daughter's hand come from?”

zh: “我想想你也不是那种人！那我这头媒，就算做成功了。好日子你们自己去挑，王太太当嫁女儿一样，有份嫁妆。至于你的聘礼，”胡雪岩说，“有两个办法，你挑一个。”“这也是新鲜话。你说个数目，我来张罗好了，哪里还有什么办法好挑？”“我做事向来与众不同。第一，我想以三方面的交情，你的聘礼可以免了。第二，如果你一定要替尊宠做面子，我放笔款子给你。两个办法你自己挑。”“我自然要给她做面子，而且已经很见王太太的情了，聘礼不可免。”嵇鹤龄沉吟了一会说，“借钱容易，还起来就难了。”“一点都不难。这趟新城的差使办成功，黄抚台一定放你出去，说不定就是雪公湖州府下面的县缺。那时候你还怕没有钱还帐。”嵇鹤龄通盘考虑了一下，认为这笔钱可以借，便点点头说：“我向宝号借一千银子。利息可要照算，不然我不借。”
en: “I don't believe you're that sort of man either. Then my work as matchmaker is done. You can choose the auspicious day yourselves. Mrs Wang will provide a dowry as though marrying off a daughter. As for your betrothal gift, there are two ways. Choose one.” “That's a new idea. Tell me the amount, and I'll find it. What is there to choose?” “I always do things differently. First, given the friendship among all three parties, I think the gift could be waived. Second, if you insist on doing your future companion proper honour, I'll lend you the money. Choose for yourself.” “Naturally I must do her honour. Besides, I already owe Mrs Wang a great deal. The betrothal gift cannot be omitted.” Ji reflected. “Borrowing is easy; repayment is difficult.” “Not difficult at all. Once you complete the Xincheng assignment, Governor Huang is certain to give you a post—perhaps a county under Mr Xuexuan's Huzhou prefecture. Would you still fear being unable to repay?” Ji considered the matter as a whole and decided the loan was reasonable. He nodded. “I'll borrow a thousand taels from your bank. But charge the usual interest, or I won't take it.”

zh: 胡雪岩不响，从马褂夹袋里掏出一叠银票，拣了一张放在嵇鹤龄面前，数目正是一千两。“你倒真痛快！”嵇鹤龄笑道：“也真巴结！”“我开钱庄做生意，怎么能不巴结？你把银票收好，如果要到我阜康立折子，找我的档手，名叫刘庆生。”“多谢了！我先写张借据。”这也现成，胡雪岩随身带着个“皮护书”，里面有空白梅红八行笺，墨盒和水笔。嵇鹤龄用他那笔凝重中不失妩媚的苏字，即席写了张借据，连同银票一起交了过去。“这为啥？”胡雪岩指着银票，诧异地问。“礼啊！”嵇鹤龄说，“我明天一早就动身了，拜托你‘大冰老爷’，代为备个全帖，送了过去。”“这也不必这么多……”“不，不！”嵇鹤龄抢着说，“十斛量珠，我自觉已太菲薄了。”
en: Without a word, Hu took a sheaf of banknotes from an inner pocket of his jacket, selected one, and laid it before Ji. It was for exactly a thousand taels. “You certainly act promptly!” Ji laughed. “And you certainly cultivate your customers!” “I run a bank. How could I do otherwise? Put the note away safely. If you'd like to open an account at Fukang, ask for my chief clerk, Liu Qingsheng.” “Thank you. First let me write a promissory note.” Hu was prepared for this too. He carried a leather writing wallet containing blank plum-red paper ruled in eight columns, an inkbox, and a brush. In his calligraphy after Su Shi, dignified yet graceful, Ji wrote out the note on the spot and handed it back together with the banknote. “Why this?” Hu asked in surprise, pointing to the money. “The betrothal gift! I leave early tomorrow, so I must trouble you, my distinguished matchmaker, to prepare the formal card and deliver it for me.” “There's no need for so much...” “No, no!” Ji interrupted. “Even ten measures of pearls would seem a meagre gift to me.”

zh: 胡雪岩想了想说：“也好。我倒再问你一声，你预备什么时候办喜事？”“既然事已定局，自然越快越好。不让我怕委屈了瑞云。”嵇鹤龄说：“果然如你所说的，新城之行，圆满归来，有个‘印把子’抓在手里，她不也算‘掌印夫人’了？”“你这样想法，我倒要劝你，”胡雪岩居然也掉了句文：“少安勿躁。”“对！我听你的话。”嵇鹤龄欣然同意：而且也要等你回来，我叫她当筵谢媒！“
en: Hu considered. “Very well. Now tell me, when do you intend to hold the wedding?” “Since it's settled, naturally the sooner the better. Otherwise I fear Ruiyun will be left in an awkward position.” Ji continued, “If, as you say, I return successfully from Xincheng and receive a magistrate's seal, won't she be an official's lady?” “If that's your thinking, I must advise you...” Hu, too, produced a literary phrase. “Have patience; do not be hasty.” “Quite right. I'll follow your advice.” Ji agreed gladly. “Besides, we must wait for you to return. I'll have her thank the matchmaker at the feast!”

zh: 他们在大谈瑞云，先还有些顾忌，轻声相语，到后来声音越说越大，瑞云想不听亦不可得，一个人悄悄坐在门背后，听得心里一阵阵发紧，有些喘不过气来，特别是那“掌印夫人”四个字，入耳应象含了块糖在嘴里。不过她始终觉得有些不大服贴的感觉，无论如何总要先探一探自己的口气！就看得那么准，把得那么稳，自作主张在商量办喜事的日子！还说“谢媒”，难道一定就知道自己不会反对？说啥是哈，听凭摆布。正在这样盘算，听得外面嵇鹤龄在喊：“瑞姑娘！”“来了！”她答应一声，手已经摸到门帘上，忽又缩了回来，摸一摸自己的脸，果然有些发烫。这样子走不出去。但不出去恰好告诉人她在偷听，想一想还是掀帘而出，却远远地垂手站着。
en: At first the two men had discussed Ruiyun in lowered voices, with some restraint. As they went on, they spoke louder and louder. Ruiyun could not have avoided hearing even if she had wished. Sitting quietly behind the door, she felt her heart tighten again and again until she almost struggled for breath. The words “an official's lady” were particularly sweet, like a piece of sugar in her mouth. Yet something continued to trouble her. Surely they ought at least to sound out her wishes first! They seemed so certain of her, so confident of their hold, that they were already deciding the wedding date between themselves. And “thank the matchmaker”! How did they know she would not object? Did they suppose she would accept whatever they said and let herself be arranged as they pleased? While she was thinking this, Ji called, “Miss Rui!” “Coming!” Her hand reached the curtain, then withdrew. She touched her face. It was indeed warm. She could hardly appear like this. Yet failing to come would reveal that she had been listening. After a moment she lifted the curtain and went out, but stood some distance away with her hands at her sides.

zh: “瑞云，”胡雪岩说道：“我要走了！”“等我来点灯笼。”她正好借此又避了开去。“不忙，不忙！我有句话问你。”“是，胡老爷请说。”“嵇老爷因为你替他管家，承情不尽，托我在上海买点东西来送你。你不必客气，喜欢什么，跟我说！”“不敢当。”瑞云答道：“怎么好要嵇老爷破费？”“不要客气，不要客气！”你自己说。“胡雪岩又说，”如果你不说，我买了一大堆来，跟你们嵇老爷算帐，反而害他大大地破费了！“
en: “Ruiyun,” Hu said, “I'm leaving.” “I'll light the lantern.” She welcomed the excuse to withdraw again. “No hurry. I have something to ask you.” “Yes, Mr Hu?” “Mr Ji is deeply grateful for your management of his household. He's asked me to buy you something in Shanghai. Don't be shy. Tell me what you'd like.” “I couldn't accept such kindness,” she replied. “How could I let Mr Ji spend money on me?” “Don't stand on ceremony. Tell me yourself. If you don't,” Hu added, “I'll buy a whole heap of things and charge them to your Mr Ji. That would cost him far more!”

zh: 瑞云心想，这位胡老爷实在厉害！也不知道他的话是真是假？真的买了一大堆用不着的东西回来，虽不是自己花钱，也会心疼。照此看来，还是自己说了为是。不过瑞云也很会说话，“胡老爷跟嵇老爷也是好朋友，不肯让嵇老爷太破费的。”她看了嵇鹤龄一眼又说：“胡老爷看着办好了。”“这也是一句话，有你这句话，我就好办事了。总而言之，包你们都满意，一个不心疼，一个不肉痛！”皮里阳秋，似嘭似谑，嵇鹤龄皱眉，瑞云脸红，她不想再站在那里，福一福说：“谢谢胡老爷跟嵇老爷！”然后转身就走。“如何？”胡雪岩很得意地说，“处处都回护着你，刚刚进门，就是贤内助了！”嵇鹤龄撮两指按在唇上，示意禁声，接着指一指里面，轻声说道：“何苦让她受窘？”胡雪岩又笑了：“好！她回护你，你回护她。看来我这头媒，做得倒真是阴功积德。”一面说，一面往外走。这时瑞云已将在打盹的张贵唤醒，点好灯笼，主仆两人把胡雪岩送出大门外，看他上了轿子才进去。
en: What a formidable man this Mr Hu was, Ruiyun thought. She could not tell whether he was serious. If he really brought back a pile of useless things, she would regret the waste even though it was not her own money. Apparently it would be better to state her wishes. Yet Ruiyun also knew how to speak. “You're Mr Ji's good friend. You wouldn't let him spend too much.” She glanced at Ji and added, “I'll leave it to your judgement.” “That's an answer too. With your permission, I can act. In short, I'll satisfy you both: one won't feel it in the heart, and the other won't feel it in the purse.” There was a hidden judgement beneath the teasing. Ji frowned and Ruiyun blushed. Unwilling to remain there, she curtsied. “Thank you, Mr Hu and Mr Ji.” Then she turned away. “Well?” Hu said triumphantly. “She's protecting your interests at every turn. She's hardly entered the house and is already a devoted helpmate!” Ji pressed two fingers to his lips for silence, pointed towards the inner rooms, and asked softly, “Why embarrass her?” Hu laughed again. “Good! She protects you, and you protect her. It seems this match really will earn me merit for doing good.” Still talking, he moved towards the door. Ruiyun had roused the drowsing Zhang Gui and lit the lantern. Master and servant accompanied Hu outside, returning only after he had entered his chair.

zh: 于是检点了行李，嵇鹤龄又嘱咐张贵，事事听“瑞姑娘”作主，小心照料门户。等男仆退出，他才问：“瑞姑娘住在哪间屋子？”“我跟二小姐一屋……”“瑞姑娘！”嵇鹤龄打断她的话说，“小孩子，不敢当你这样的称呼。你叫她名字好了，她叫丹荷……“他把他六个儿子的名字，一一告诉了她。“叫名字我也不敢。”瑞云平静地答道，“叫官官吧！”江南缙绅之家，通称子女叫“官”，或者用排行，或者用名字，丹荷就是“荷官”，这是个不分尊卑的“官称”，嵇鹤龄便也不再“谦辞”了。
en: Ji checked his luggage, then instructed Zhang Gui to obey Miss Rui in everything and guard the house carefully. When the servant had withdrawn, he asked, “Which room are you using, Miss Rui?” “I'm sharing with the Second Miss...” “Miss Rui,” Ji interrupted, “she's only a child. She doesn't deserve such a formal title from you. Call her by her name. It's Danhe...” He told her the names of all six children. “I wouldn't presume to call them simply by name either,” Ruiyun answered calmly. “I'll use guan.” In Jiangnan gentry households, children were commonly addressed with guan, attached either to their place in the family or to part of their name. Danhe would thus become Heguan. It was a customary form that implied neither superiority nor inferiority, so Ji offered no further polite objection.

zh: “瑞姑娘，我再说一句，舍间完全奉托了！孩子们都要请你照应。”“嵇老爷你请放心，府上的事都有我。”瑞云这时对他的感觉不同了，隐隐然有终身倚靠的念头，所以对他此行的安危，不能不关心，但话又不便明说，只这样问起，“嵇老爷这趟出门，不晓得哪天才能回来？”“也不会太久，快则半个月，最多一个月工夫，我相信公事一定可以办好了。”“听说这趟公事很麻烦？”“事在人为。”嵇鹤龄说了这句成语，怕她不懂，因而又作解释：“事情要看什么人办？我去了，大概可以办得下来。”“如果办不下来呢？”办不下来就性命交关了！嵇鹤龄也体谅得到她的心情，怕吓了她，不肯说实话。“不要紧！”他用极具信心的语气说：“一定办得来。”
en: “Let me say again, Miss Rui: I entrust the entire household to you, and all the children to your care.” “Set your mind at rest, Mr Ji. I'll attend to everything here.” Ruiyun now felt differently about him. A vague sense that he might become her lifelong support made her concerned for his safety on this journey. Yet she could not say so plainly and merely asked, “When do you expect to return?” “It shouldn't take long. A fortnight if things go quickly, a month at most. I'm confident I can settle the business.” “I hear it's a very troublesome affair?” “Much depends on the man.” Afraid she might not understand the saying, Ji explained, “It depends on who handles it. If I go, I should be able to manage.” “And if you can't?” If he failed, his life would be at stake. But he understood her feelings and would not frighten her with the truth. “Don't worry,” he said with complete confidence. “I shall certainly manage it.”

zh: 瑞云的脸上，果然是宽慰的表情。她还有许多话想问，苦于第一天见面，身分限制，难以启齿。但又舍不得走，就只好低头站在那里，作出伺候垂询的样子。嵇鹤龄觉得气氛有些僵硬，不便于深谈，便说了句：“你请坐！以后见面的日子还有，一拘束，就不象一家人了。”这话说得相当露骨，如果照他的话坐下来，便等于承认是“一家人”了。她心里虽异常关切嵇鹤龄，但表面上却不愿有任何倾心委身的表示，因为一则不免羞涩，再则对他和胡雪岩还存着一丝莫名其妙的反感，有意矜持。看她依旧站着，嵇鹤龄很快地又说了句：“你请坐啊！”“不要紧！”她还是不肯依。于是嵇鹤龄不自觉地也站了起来，捧着一管水烟袋，一路捻纸捻，一路跟她说话，主要的是问她的家世，瑞云有问必答，一谈谈到三更天，方始各归寝室。
en: Ruiyun's face did indeed relax. She had many more questions, but it was their first day together, and the limits of her position made them hard to ask. Yet she could not bear to leave. She stood with her head lowered, as though waiting for further instructions. Ji found the atmosphere stiff and unsuitable for deeper conversation. “Please sit down. We shall have many more days together. If we're so constrained, we won't feel like one family.” The words were quite explicit. Sitting as he asked would amount to acknowledging that they were one family. Though she cared greatly about him, she did not want to show openly that she had given him her heart and her future. She was shy; besides, a trace of inexplicable resentment towards him and Hu remained, prompting deliberate reserve. Seeing her still standing, Ji quickly repeated, “Do sit down.” “I'm quite all right.” She still would not comply. Without realising it, Ji rose too. Holding his water pipe and twisting paper spills, he talked with her, chiefly asking about her family background. She answered every question. They continued until the third watch before finally going to their separate rooms.

zh: 这应该是嵇鹤龄悼亡以后，睡得最舒服的一夜，因为他的床铺经瑞云彻底的整理过了，雪白的夏布帐子，抹得极干净的草席，新换的枕头衣。大床后面的搁板上，收拾得整整齐齐，有茶有书，帐子外的一盏油灯，剔得极亮，如果睡不着可以看书消遣。他睡不着，但也不曾看书，双眼已有些涩倦，而神思亢奋，心里想到许多事，最要紧的一件是新城之行的估量。最初激于胡雪岩的交情，王有龄的礼遇，挺身而出，不计后果，此刻想想，不能只凭一股锐气，做了再说。到新城以后，如何下手，固非临机不可，但是成败之算，应有筹划。身入危城，随便什么人不可能有万全之计，倘或被害，身后六个儿女怎么办？当然，朝廷有抚恤，上官会周济，然而这都要看人的恩惠，总得有个切实可靠，能够托孤的人才好。
en: This should have been Ji's most comfortable night since his bereavement. Ruiyun had thoroughly put his bed in order: spotless white ramie curtains, a scrupulously wiped sleeping mat, and a fresh pillow cover. The shelf behind the large bed was neatly arranged, with tea and books ready. Outside the curtains, the oil lamp had been trimmed to burn brightly, so he could read if unable to sleep. He could not sleep, but he did not read. His eyes were already dry and tired, while his mind remained excited and crowded with thoughts. Above all, he was assessing the journey to Xincheng. At first, moved by Hu's friendship and Wang's courtesy, he had volunteered without counting the consequences. Now he saw that he could not simply act on courage and consider the rest afterwards. What to do on arrival would necessarily depend on circumstances, but success and failure both required forethought. No one entering a city in danger could devise an entirely safe plan. If he were killed, what would become of his six children? Naturally there would be an allowance from the court and help from his superiors. But these depended on others' generosity. He needed someone truly dependable to whom he could entrust the children if they were orphaned.

zh: 念头转到这里，自然就想到了胡雪岩。心里不免失悔，如果早见及此，趁今晚上就可以切切实实拜托一番，现在只好留个“遗嘱”了。于是他重新起身，把油灯移到桌上，展开纸笔，却又沉吟不定。留遗嘱似乎太严重了些，这对胡雪岩会是很大的一个负担。考虑了很久，忽有妙悟，自己觉得很得意。
en: This naturally brought Hu to mind. Ji regretted not having considered it sooner. Had he done so, he could have made a serious, explicit request that evening. Now he could only leave something like a will. He rose again, moved the lamp to the table, and laid out paper and brush, but hesitated. A will seemed too grave. It would place a heavy burden on Hu. He considered for a long while, then suddenly found an ingenious solution that pleased him greatly.
